turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Nice, a climbing session with Sam sounds like a blast. Have you eaten yet, or are you guys planning a lunch spot?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Yum, that sounds delicious and energizing for climbing. How has work been lately at the logistics firm? Ready for a break from being an account coordinator?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh absolutely. It was a hectic week dealing with shipping delays, so this weekend is much needed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine, those supply chain puzzles must be exhausting. I hope the climbing wall helps you blow off some steam!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! It definitely will. I'm going to grab my gear and head out soon. Talk to you later!
